title: Senior Support Engineer (Asterisk)
description: Company Description VoiceSpin is a leading provider of cloud-based AI contact center solutions, serving SMEs and large enterprises across diverse industries such as healthcare, telemarketing, education, insurance, and retail. Our platform combines advanced AI technologies, including AI voice bots, predictive dialing, chatbots, omnichannel messaging, and speech analytics, into one seamless solution. With access to local numbers in over 160 countries and integration capabilities with more than 80 popular CRMs like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zendesk, VoiceSpin offers tailored solutions to meet unique business needs. We are dedicated to empowering businesses with innovative and eﬃcient communication Tools. Eligible locations: Armenia, Ukraine, Turkey, Azerbaijan About the Role VoiceSpin is expanding its engineering team and is looking for an experienced VoIP Engineer to help build and maintain the telephony backbone of our cloud-based contact center platform. You will design, configure and optimize VoIP infrastructure built on Linux, Asterisk and SIP, ensuring high call quality and reliability for enterprise clients worldwide. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex telephony challenges and working with open-source technologies. What You'll Do -Serve as the 2nd 3rd tier for customers seeking technical assistance on the Voicespin products over the phone, email or chat -Perform remote troubleshooting through diagnostic techniques and pertinent questions by customers -Walk the customer through the problem-solving process -Direct unresolved issues to the next level of support -Provide accurate information on Voicespin IT products and services -Record events, issues and resolutions in logs -Follow-up and update customer status and information -Pass on any feedback or suggestion by customers to the appropriate internal team -Identify and suggest possible improvements on procedures Requirements Linux administration Asterisk (4+ years of experience) VICI Dialer Understanding SIP protocol Knowledge of VoIP Knowledge of SQL (Especially MySQL, Mariadb) Scripting knowledge (at least one: Bash, PHP, Python) English - upper-intermediate+ Nice to Have Knowledge of LLMs, TTS and STT services. Google Cloud and AWS Networking Web services and APIs What We Offer Collaborative engineering culture focused on innovation and rapid execution. Strong growth within the team; Long-term employment; Paid vacation and sick leave; English classes; Paid health insurance. Remote format of work.

title: İş Analisti
description: Biz Kimiz? Gratis olarak kendine güzel bakmayı herkes için ulaşılabilir kılmayı hedefliyoruz. Sedes Holding çatısı altında, 2009’dan bu yana 81 ilde 740’ı aşkın mağazamız ve 15 kategoride 15.000’den fazla ürünümüzle Türkiye’nin lider kişisel bakım perakende markalarından biriyiz. Ama hikâyemiz yalnızca ürünlerden ibaret değil. Bu, sürekli büyüyen bir ekosisteme yön veren insan kaynağımızın hikayesi… Biz Nasıl Çalışırız? Hızlı hareket eder, merak eder, keşfeder ve değişime liderlik ederiz. Gelişen mağaza ağımız ve güçlü dijital altyapımızla alışveriş deneyimini sürekli yeniden tanımlarız. 2017’de açtığımız ilk Beauty mağazasıyla perakendeyi hizmet deneyimiyle buluşturduk. Bugün 12 ilde 57 Beauty merkeziyle aynı kalite ve standartta hizmet sunuyoruz. 2022’de kurduğumuz Beauty Akademi ile eğitimi istihdama dönüştüren sürdürülebilir bir model geliştirdik. Kültürümüz 8.000’den fazla kadın çalışma arkadaşımızla; mağaza ekiplerinin tamamının kadınlardan oluştuğu bir marka olarak cesareti, dayanışmayı ve gelişimi birlikte büyütüyoruz. Eğer sen de… Hızlı büyüyen, yeniliği merkezine alan bir ekibin parçası olmak ve perakendenin dönüşümüne katkı sağlamak istiyorsan, Gratis’in güçlü ve dinamik ekosisteminde yerini al… GENEL NİTELİKLER Üniversitelerin Matematik, Bilgisayar, Elektronik, Endüstri, İşletme Mühendislikleri veya Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri (MIS), İstatistik bölümlerinden mezun, En az 4-5 yıl yazılım projelerinde İş Analisti olarak görev almış, İş / Sistem analizi konusunda deneyimli, E-ticaret projelerinde görev almış, e-ticaret operasyonları ve CRM süreçlerine hakim, E-ticaret entegrasyonları ve e-commerce altyapıları hakkında bilgi sahibi, İş analizi metodolojileri ve teknikleri konusunda bilgili, tercihen bu alanda eğitim almış, Cross-functional diagram, sequence diagram gibi modelleme araçlarını kullanarak iş süreçlerini soyutlayabilen, SDLC ve Agile proje yönetim metodolojilerine hakim, JIRA, Git gibi yazılım geliştirme araçlarını etkin kullanabilen, Postman gibi API test araçlarıyla çalışma tecrübesi olan, tercihen RESTful API’ler, ilişkisel veri tabanları ve SQL konusunda bilgi sahibi, Web tabanlı uygulamalar ve e-ticaret sistemleri konusunda deneyimli, Yazılım test süreçleri ve metodolojileri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tedarikçi yönetimi konusunda tecrübeli, Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yeteneği güçlü, sonuç odaklı ve takip yönü kuvvetli, Takım çalışmasına yatkın, farklı disiplinlerle iş birliği yaparak süreçleri yönlendirebilen, Ocak 2027'ye kadar İstanbul Levent Genel Merkezimizde, Ocak 2027'den itibaren ise yeni çalışma lokasyonumuz Kocaeli Gebze'de çalışabilecek. İŞ TANIMI İş birimlerinden gelen yazılım geliştirme, entegrasyon ve modelleme taleplerini analiz ederek ön çalışmaların yürütülmesi, Gereksinimlerin netleştirilmesi ve geliştirme sürecine yönelik iş akışları, modellemeler ve dokümantasyonun hazırlanması, Fonksiyonel ve süreç analizlerinin gerçekleştirilerek kapsam dahilinde tasarım ve dokümantasyon süreçlerinin yönetilmesi, Uygulama ara yüzlerinin işlevselliğini artırmaya yönelik yönlendirmelerde bulunulması, Yazılım ekipleriyle sürekli iletişimde kalarak proje boyunca bilgi paylaşımının ve teknik desteğin sağlanması, Geliştirilen çözümlerin ön testlerinin yürütülmesi, iş birimiyle son kullanıcı testlerinin koordine edilmesi ve sonuçların yazılım ekipleriyle paylaşılması, Sistem ve süreç değişikliklerinin takibinin yapılması, ilgili paydaşların bilgilendirilmesi ve gerekli durumlarda eğitim dokümanlarının hazırlanması, Risk, kalite ve değişim yönetimi süreçlerine katkı sağlanması, Proje ilerleme raporlarının hazırlanarak yönetime destek verilmesi, Raporlama ve analiz ihtiyaçlarının karşılanması.

title: Senior Software Developer / Architect - Telecommunications Platform
description: TEASOL Technologies is a deep-tech telecom startup specializing in next-generation mobile network sharing automation. Our flagship platform, TEASOL Exchange, enables MNOs, MVNOs, Neutral Host Providers, and Private Network Operators to dynamically share underutilized network infrastructure and capacity. Location: Üsküdar, Istanbul Working Model: Hybrid JOB DESCRIPTION Join our innovative telecom software team as a Senior Software Developer / Architect, where you’ll design and build the core systems powering next-generation 5G/6G and private mobile networks. You’ll play a leading role in developing scalable, high-performance, and reliable software platforms that connect millions of users across the globe. In this role, you will: • Architect and build distributed software components and APIs for telecom platforms. • Drive performance optimization and reliability across carrier-grade systems. • Collaborate with cross-functional experts to integrate with OSS/BSS, NFV, RAN, and core systems. • Shape architecture decisions and bring ideas to life using microservices, containers, and cutting-edge frameworks. • Mentor developers, promote coding excellence, and contribute to our culture of technical innovation. QUALIFICATIONS • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Telecommunications. • 5+ years of software development experience (preferably in telecom, networking, or distributed systems). • Advanced coding skills in Go, C++, Java, or Python. • Expertise in microservices, Docker/Kubernetes, and REST/gRPC APIs. • Strong understanding of networking protocols and telecom frameworks (3GPP, O-RAN, NFV). • Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, or Cassandra. • Familiarity with CI/CD, observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK), and cloud-native platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). • A proactive, collaborative mindset and a passion for designing scalable systems.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineering team—it’s core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turn technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end-to-end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. For Toptal Use Only: #canada #southamerica #europe #easterneurope #northerneurope
